Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo

Record Class MongoQuerySpec

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo.MongoQuerySpec
public record MongoQuerySpec(String filter, String projection, String sort, int skip, int limit) extends Record
One query as the Compass-style query bar states it: filter, projection, sort, skip and limit.

Keeping these as separate fields rather than one JSON blob is the point — they are what the driver takes, what a saved favourite stores, and what can be validated individually before a round-trip. Blank parts are simply not applied.
